text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(Why... Why did I have to run into Trainer 
at that exact moment... Why?)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(While I was buying a book called '100 
Ways to Improve Your Social Skills', of 
all things...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(............However, the book said: "If 
you make a mistake, turn it into a joke to 
close the distance!" In other words—)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"'Man, you caught me at an embarrassing 
moment! Don't go telling anyone, okay? 
Ahaha♪'"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Fufufufu. I really don't feel like 
I can pull this off...
